questions.stem: In the capture-recapture method, what assumption must be made for the population estimate to be valid?

options.text: No organisms have moved in or out of the area, and none have been born or died between sampling
The organisms must all be the same species
The marking must change the organisms behaviour
All organisms must be the same size

questions.explanation: For the capture-recapture method to give a valid estimate, it must be assumed that no organisms have immigrated, emigrated, been born, or died between the two sampling events. The marks must also not affect the organisms survival or make them easier to spot by predators.
